2026-11-18.title: Korea plans chronic care fees for COPD and asthma in 2027
2026-11-18.summary: Dailymedi reports that the Ministry of Health and Welfare plans to extend chronic disease management fees to COPD and asthma in 2027. The fees would support clinics that provide education and counseling to patients with chronic respiratory disease.
2026-11-18.takeaway: Respiratory care suppliers can watch for details on how clinics will deliver and document patient education.

2026-11-18.title: Ewha medical center patents AI-based device tracking
2026-11-18.summary: Ewha Womans University Medical Center registered a patent for a system that combines location and prescription data to identify which devices were used. The system draws on device usage and repair histories to support preventive maintenance and recall response.
2026-11-18.takeaway: The patent illustrates how hospitals are exploring device tracking as part of safety and maintenance workflows.

2026-11-18.title: Novartis links Korean radioligand investment to patient access
2026-11-18.summary: Novartis announced plans in July to invest about KRW 140 billion in Korean radioligand therapy manufacturing and logistics. In a November interview, its Korea chief identified patient access as a key factor, with no construction timetable set.
2026-11-18.takeaway: The investment illustrates how access and reimbursement conditions can shape decisions about local manufacturing.
